title: Segmented DAC
text: Convert large digital input to analog signal using arrangement of smaller DACs, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Gain error unit} sets Unit of gain error; {Input polarity} defines DAC input data, {Use external start clock} sets the connect to external start conversion clock, {Conversion start frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {Reference (V)} sets the dAC output reference magnitude, {Bias (V)} sets the difference between analog output for code zero and analog, {Settling time (s)} sets the time required for output, {Settling time tolerance (LSB)} sets the tolerance for calculating settling time, {Bit width} sets the number of physical input bits for DAC segment integer scalar greater than or equal, {Bits} sets the bit ranges of each, {Topology}, {Offset error} sets the shift quantization steps, {Offset error unit} sets the unit of offset, {Gain error} sets the error in slope of DAC transfer curve, {Move selected segment up}, {Move selected segment down}, {New Segment} adds new DAC, {Duplicate Selected} sets the duplicate selected segment and {Delete Selected} sets the delete selected segment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

params.values: Define DAC input data polarity Unipolar (default) | Bipolar

params.values: Connect to external start conversion clock on (default) | off

params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 1e6 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Reference (V)
params.values: DAC output reference magnitude 0.5 (default) | real scalar

params.values: Tolerance for calculating settling time 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Bit width
params.values: Number of physical input bits for DAC segment integer scalar greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Bits

params.name: Offset error unit
params.values: Unit of offset error LSB (default) | FS | %FS

params.name: Gain error
params.values: Error in slope of DAC transfer curve 0 (default) | real scalar

params.values: Unit of gain error LSB (default) | FS | %FS
